name: ITC Hotels Limited
remarksWeb: 1. The shareholding of the Promoter is locked-in as per the SEBI Master Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/POD-2/P/CIR/2023/93 dated 20th June, 2023.  2. In B4 (m) -'Any Other (specify)'- 'Unclaimed or Suspense or Escrow Account' consist of 1,45,709 fully paid-up equity shares held in the Unclaimed Suspense Account and 39,78,254 fully paid-up equity shares held in the Escrow Demat Account.  3. In terms of the FAQs on Disclosure of Holding of Specified Securities and Holding of Specified Securities in Dematerialized Form issued by NSE on 9th July 2025, both Wimco and SNBPL have been removed from the list of Promoter/Promoter group companies. Apart from this, there is no change in the Promoter/Promoter group companies or their holdings.
